decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits close to the core pipeline offer, was promoted to its own page in 2019, and costs little to carry, so the option still justifies keeping it.
The public waste bin is distant from the core business but uses existing powder-coating capacity, so carrying it costs little while municipal demand is still uncertain.
This multi-model line is far from the core and adds the carrying cost of several variants on top of Product D, and with no evidence of traction since 2019 the option appears unlikely to pay off.
Outdoor ashtrays are distant from the core, but they share the coating process and municipal customers, so a low-cost option remains worth holding while uncertainty lasts.
